items.note: The prompt asks the receiver to tell the CEO whether the July Pro price increase (49 to 69 USD) drove Pro churn.
The prompt says to exclude trials (is_trial = yes) before any calculation.
The prompt says to exclude test accounts with emails ending in @ourco.test.
The prompt defines churn as an account having a cancel_month.
The prompt names the CEO as the audience: 'I need to tell the CEO' and 'Output, for the CEO.'
The prompt asks for a summary of at most 5 bullets.
The prompt asks for one suggested chart, saying only what to plot and not building it.
The prompt asks for a statement of how confident the conclusion is, given the small sample, with the reason.
